search_text: published ZDI-26-197 ZDI-CAN-26338 (Pwn2Own) ChargePoint Home Flex revssh Service Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2026-03-16 CVE-2026-4157 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-4157 7.5 AV:A/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['ChargePoint'] ['Home Flex'] This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of ChargePoint Home Flex devices. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of OCPP messages. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root. title: (Pwn2Own) ChargePoint Home Flex revssh Service Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of ChargePoint Home Flex devices. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of OCPP messages. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root.
